henry.title: Twinkle on Piano and Ukulele
henry.mission: Play the first Twinkle phrase on the piano, then strum C and F on the ukulele while you sing.
henry.done: You played the piano phrase, strummed C then F, and answered problems 1 through 5.
words: the same tune, played a new way
more than one note at the same time

flow.title: Piano phrase
flow.teach:
Twinkle uses an old French tune. Mozart wrote 12 variations on it. A variation is the same tune, played a new way.

Find C: the white key just to the left of the two black keys. Play C C G G A A G.

If the video will not play, hum Twinkle and then play.
link: Listen: first minute of Mozart's variations
Hum the tune if the video will not play.
pics: C is the white key just left of the two black keys.
sheets: The Twinkle tune came from: France / Japan
A variation is: the same tune changed / a brand-new song
Piano: C C G G A A ___

flow.title: Ukulele C, then F
flow.teach:
Look at the pictures. C uses one finger: the ring finger on the A string, fret 3.

F uses two fingers. Pointer finger on the E string, fret 1. Middle finger on the G string, fret 2.

Strum C four times, then F four times. Sing "Twinkle, twinkle" on C and "little" on F.
pics: C: ring finger on the A string, fret 3.
F: pointer on E at fret 1, middle finger on G at fret 2.
sheets: F chord: pointer finger on the ____ string, fret 1. Middle finger on the ____ string, fret 2.
I played the piano phrase, then strummed C and F. Circle: yes / not yet

henry.challenge:
Optional. Play C C G G A A G a new way: softer, faster, or bouncy. That is your variation.

If a guitar is out, pluck one open string, then pluck the ukulele. Which sounds lower?
henry.adult:
The cello is broken. Leave it in the case. Do not hand it to him. A guitar is only for the optional challenge.

He is a beginner. An honest attempt at the piano phrase and at switching from C to F is a full music score, along with problems 1 through 4.

parentKey.assess: Score a real attempt at the piano phrase, a real attempt at C then F, and correct answers on problems 1 through 4. Problem 5 is his own yes. The challenge is not scored.

items.a: Pointer on the E string, fret 1. Middle finger on the G string, fret 2. This matches the F-chord picture.
Yes, if he tried both parts. Not yet means finish the playing before you score a 5.
Any real change in speed or volume. A guitar's low open string usually sounds lower than the ukulele. Either observation he can defend is fine.

frankie.title: Twinkle Numbers and the Big Dipper
frankie.mission: Play the number tune, place 7 paper dots or stickers like the Big Dipper picture, and write dot.
frankie.done: You finished the number tune, placed 7 marks like the picture, matched the words, and wrote dot.

flow.title: Number tune
flow.teach:
Grown-up, before he starts: put paper dots, coins, or stickers on piano keys 1 through 6. You do not need to buy stickers. Key 1 is C, the white key just left of the two black keys. Key 6 is the next white key after key 5.

He presses 1 1 5 5 6 6 5, then 4 4 3 3 2 2 1. Sing with him.
pics: Key 1 is C, just left of the two black keys.

flow.title: Seven stars like the picture
flow.teach: Copy the Big Dipper picture on this page. Use 7 paper dots, coins, or stickers. 3 go in the handle. 4 go in the cup. This is the one art job this week.
pics: Copy this Big Dipper. 3 in the handle, 4 in the cup.
sheets: Stretch, only if you want it: a cloud covers 2 of the 7 stars. How many still shine? ____

flow.title: Read and write dot
flow.teach: Grown-up, name the pictures first: a blue dot, a pig, a cup (the mug).
sheets: Draw a line. Words: dot, pig, cup. Pictures: cup ☕   blue dot 🔵   pig 🐷.

Circle every is: It is a star. It is big.
Trace: a big star.
Write dot: __________

frankie.adult: Set out keys 1 through 6 with paper dots or stickers before the timer. Do not require a store-bought sticker pack. The picture to copy is the Big Dipper on this page. The cello stays in its case.

parentKey.assess: Score the tune number, 7 stars placed like the picture, 3 + 4, the word match, and writing dot. The cloud question is optional.

items.a: 7. He should place 7 marks like the Big Dipper picture.
dot to the blue dot, pig to the pig, cup to the mug.
Both is words circled. He traces and writes dot.
